_about: Per-site settings for commbench-run.sh, one entry per SITE argument.
launcher: the command that starts a multi-process run; 'lcrun' means one host, no Slurm
(commbench-run.sh then runs P0 directly and P2/P2i through the build's lcrun).
env: variables exported before the run. env_default: exported only if not already set.
modules: environment modules loaded before the run.
modules_if_linked: modules loaded only if libreconverse links a library matching
'pattern' (ldd); lib_dir_var names a variable the module sets, whose lib/ goes first
single_node_flags: launcher flags for the placements that use one host (P0, P2, P2i).
Use SITES_FILE=path to read another file; add a machine by adding an entry.

modules_if_linked._why: a build configured against the hwloc 1.11 module (libhwloc.so.5) needs it; a build against Open MPI's hwloc 2.5.0 (libhwloc.so.15, found through RPATH) must not load it
